product_summary: Pune (Shelpimpalgaon, Tal. Khed, Dist. Pune, Maharashtra 410501) company, part of 'Avenue Group of Companies', operating alongside 'Agrovan'; site states inaugurated 2016. Self-described as 'primary manufacturer' of Frozen, Canned, Dehydrated & spices, Fresh and Ready-to-eat. Published catalogue (unityagrofoods.com/product.html) is dominated by: (1) FRESH produce - pomegranate (Bhagwa/Arkata/Ganesh), mango (Kesar/Alphonso), grapes, G9 banana, red & white onions, green chillies, lemon, fresh ginger; (2) FROZEN vegetables - sweet corn on cob (whole & mini), sweet corn kernels, green peas, 3-way and 4-way mixed vegetables, cut beans, chopped spinach, spinach puree, ginger paste, green & red chilli paste, baby corn (cut/whole), cauliflower, red/white onion slices & 10x10 dices, French fries 6 mm and 9 mm; (3) FROZEN fruit - Totapuri mango dice/slices, Alphonso mango slices, whole strawberry, chickoo slices, pomegranate arils. Canned, ready-to-eat, dehydrated and spices are listed only as top-level categories with no SKU detail on the page.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader - site claims own manufacturing ('primary manufacturer', plant address at APMC Market Shelpimpalgaon) and organic farm services, but the fresh-produce lines (grapes, banana, pomegranate, mango, onion) are classic Indian agri-trading/export items and the plant address is an APMC market yard, which is a trading/mandi location rather than an industrial processing unit. Mixed manufacturer + trader profile is the most defensible reading; no customs line available to confirm either way.
comment: HS mapping vs declaration: PARTIAL. Two of four declared codes are directly corroborated by the published catalogue - 071040 (frozen sweet corn on cob / mini cob / kernels) and 071080 (frozen green peas, mixed vegetables, cut beans, spinach, baby corn, cauliflower, frozen onion). Two declared codes are NOT corroborated: 200580 (sweet corn prepared/preserved, non-frozen) has no matching SKU - the site's sweet corn is all frozen, which sits in 071040; and 200820 (prepared/preserved pineapples) has no pineapple product anywhere on the site, so it looks like a copy-paste or a legacy line - status 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Significant product lines are MISSING from the declaration: frozen potato French fries (200410), frozen fruit - mango dice/slices, strawberry, chickoo, pomegranate arils (081190), and the entire fresh-produce range - mango, pomegranate, grapes, banana, onion, chilli, lemon, ginger (0804/0805/0703/0709/0910). The fresh range is arguably the company's core export business and its complete absence from the declared codes is the biggest gap. Industry classification 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is broadly correct but too generic: the real profile is frozen/processed fruit-and-vegetable processing plus fresh agri-produce trading, not FMCG branded goods. Trader signs: APMC Market plant address, e-mail on gmail.com, toll-free + two mobile numbers, no factory/industrial-estate address, and a sister brand ('Agrovan') under a group umbrella - consistent with a trading house with some processing/repacking capability rather than a pure processor. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: company stays in the base, declared codes should be corrected to the actual range above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product data here comes from the company's own website (unityagrofoods.com, home page and product.html) and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no customs line, B/L or GST record was checked in this HS-only pass, so no shipment fact is asserted. Certificates page exists but was not read; no revenue, CIN, PAN or registration data researched per scope.
